_: The user half of the summary prompt, as ordered segments. Appended in order when each condition holds; slots are literal tokens substituted by replacement, never by a format function, because the prompt contains JSON braces. Deliberately not a template language: a mini-language is itself a thing two implementations can disagree about. The conditions are a closed vocabulary and the only logic is presence.
